platform: High Tea Music Drum and Bass Official Fillout Demo Form
manual_review_reason: High Tea Music directs all label demos to a third-party Fillout form. A human must inspect the live form fields, file or link requirements, rights declarations, privacy terms, cookie choices and any runtime verification before entering artist data or music. Do not send demos to the public label or general email addresses as a substitute for the authorized form.

platform: Liquicity Records Drum and Bass Label Engine Demo Upload Route
manual_review_reason: Liquicity directs all music submissions to a Label Engine form that requests artist and real names, email confirmation, up to five MP3 tracks, track titles, optional social profiles and a message. A human must select the final tracks, confirm metadata, rights, file quality, privacy implications and any runtime challenge before upload. Do not use Liquicity's general contact form for demos.

platform: Circus Records and Circus Electric LabelRadar Bass Music Demo Route
manual_review_reason: Circus Records accepts demos only through its external LabelRadar route. A human must select the correct Circus label, review any credit or plan boundary, verify rights and metadata, and approve the track upload. Do not email demos to info@circus-records.co.uk.

platform: Monstercat Uncaged Instinct and Silk Official LabelRadar Demo Portals

A human must inspect any credits, terms, rights declarations, cookies, runtime controls and upload requirements. Do not repurpose Monstercat's support, press, event or general contact form for demos.
